purpose: Quantify the sample sizes required for four multiplicity-controlled component contrasts and determine whether existing artifacts supply valid proposal-, library- or envelope-level units.

multiplicity_plan.confirmatory_rule: Holm step-down familywise error control at 0.05.
multiplicity_plan.test: One-sided exact conditional McNemar/sign test on paired discordant units.

alternative_parameters.r: Probability that the full and ablated arms disagree on one valid unit.
alternative_parameters.q: Probability that the full arm wins conditional on disagreement.

multiplicity_plan.calculation: For each N, integrate the exact conditional rejection probability over D~Binomial(N,r); reject for the smallest treatment-win count whose Binomial(D,0.5) upper tail is at most 0.0125.

proposal_level.reason_excluded: Per-instance formulations are endpoint attempts, and the legacy skill identities use incompatible or already-open protocols; neither class is an exchangeable component-ablation proposal population.

library_selection_level.reason_not_reusable: The successful libraries were separately authored for different benchmark families and were not selected twice from one frozen candidate pool with and without the same description code.

routing_envelope_level.reason_not_reusable: The retrospective known-envelope study establishes identity preservation but contains no intervention headroom for selective routing under ambiguity or shift.

design_consequences: Do not relabel the five historical proposals, 229 per-instance trajectories or six legacy identities as a powered matched component population.
Use one prospectively frozen proposal pool for semantic-verifier and resource-admission interventions; their units may be shared, but each contrast retains its own paired outcomes.
Generate independent or validly clustered library-selection episodes before estimating a complexity-control effect; benchmark rows are not repeated selection episodes.
Build a separate answer-free routing cohort with prespecified zero-, unique- and multiple-match opportunities before estimating selective-routing utility.
Use a small pilot only to estimate r and failure taxonomy. Freeze the confirmatory N from an independent or alpha-accounted rule before opening confirmatory outcomes.

If the required library-level replication is infeasible, narrow the empirical claim to verifier/resource and routing mechanisms and retain complexity control as a theory-motivated design principle rather than claiming causal benefit.

decision.permitted_claim: The existing artifacts do not contain valid powered units for any of the four component effects; exact planning targets are now fixed for displayed alternatives.
prohibited_claims: Historical endpoint trajectories are independent skill-proposal trials.
The two authored family libraries identify a description-length effect.
Known-envelope exact routing identifies selective-routing benefit.
Thirty-eight endpoint identities provide 80 percent power for the moderate r=.30,q=.70 alternative after four-contrast control.
